programmes.d: In the midst of a global pandemic the girls continue to social distance, but it's not because of COVID-19, and Pauly is full of surprises as the roomies learn he's not quarantining alone.

Desperate times call for desperate measures and the guys are ready for a family vacation R,S,V,P have a sneaky surprise to get the girls back together, but Deena has a surprise of her own that could complicate everything
The countdown to Angelina's arrival is on and the guys need to figure out how to break the news to Deena. Meanwhile, the squad tries to play matchmaker by creating a dating show for Single Ronnie.
Hosted by dating show experts: DJ Pauly D and Vinny Guadagnino, 6 girls will compete for the love of the ultimate bachelor, Ronnie Magro, on the brand new dating show, "A trouble shot at love."
The double book comes full circle as Angelina touches down In lake Las Vegas. But her arrival has Deena on edge, Vinny ducking punches, and The Situation overwhelmed.
The situation forgets the plan at dinner, and then forgets he's on a TV show. And a text from back home rattles the roommates and threatens to blow the whole vacation up.
Pauly scrambles to get Deena and Angelina on board with a family dinner before Nikki arrives. But a mob of raccoons almost foils his plan. Meanwhile, back in Jersey, Jenni is having some major fomo.

Pauly brings Nikki to family dinner, and the guys hold their breath as Deena and Angelina come face to face for the first time in 10 months. But Vinny's offhanded comment about a wedding speech could derail everything.
Angelina and Deena have buried the hatchet, and the family vacation can officially begin. But Jenni's arrival is about the change everything.
JWOWW and Angelina put the A in awkward at family dinner. Afterwards, the guys are at a loss so Ronnie calls in a favor from Dr. Drew to see if he can help bring the family back together.

Dr. Drew helps mediate the conflict between Angelina and Jenni. A messy situation is about to get messier when Deena learns her private conversation with Mike wasn't so private. Mike and Lauren get the best news of their lives.
RSVP plan Angelina's wedding redo. Uncle Nino is officiating and Vinny is giving the wedding speech. What could go wrong?
Ten months after a bridesmaids speech almost destroyed the family, Angelina gets her wedding redo, while Mike tries to keep his secret until after the festivities.

The gang is back together and big changes are in the air. Pauly D has a new look, Vinny is looking for a new home, and when social media explodes with rumors about Angelina & Chris's marriage, Mike takes on a new alter ego -The Investigation.

The honeymoon might be over for Angelina after Chris moves out. But Mike has a lot to celebrate as he reaches his five-year soberversary. To mark the occasion the roomies throw a parade in his honor and the surprise return of a certain roommate.

Snooki returns to celebrate Mike's five-year Soberversary, and the roommates begin to plan their next big family vacation. But everything comes to a screeching halt when a wild rumor surfaces involving Angelina, her marriage, and chicken tenders.

A boozy brunch with Snooki and Angelina goes sideways when Snooki spills the beans about the video "evidence" of Angelina in Old Bridge. Chris moves back home. And the roommates head to the Poconos for their big winter vacation.

Jenni has a huge announcement. But before the celebration can begin, the roommates must deal with the elephant in the room currently casting a rather large shadow over their Poconos vacation - videos of Angelina and her mystery man in Old Bridge, NJ.
Vinny suffers an unspeakable loss; Angelina confronts Jenni about the videos; and the roommates try their hand at winter sports.
